note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved; ZInQ.Syntax.Node.denote a definition: Node semantics in stored order, calls, fixed integer expressions, the 22-prime catalogue and psi_component have matching definitions; the fixed point codes (iota_eq_psi_unconditional) and the zero set of the finite guard product (guardPoly_eval_eq_zero_iff) are proved. [F]'s templates are built from formulas rather than stored node lists, so Node.denote is the semantics, not the source of the library.

noncomputable def Node.denote (I : Constructors E) (lib : List ExPoly) (vals : List Poly) :
    Node E → Poly
  | .const c => C c
  | .var i => X i
  | .add j k => getPoly vals j + getPoly vals k
  | .mul j k => getPoly vals j * getPoly vals k
  | .call t args w => (getEx lib t).callList (args.map (getPoly vals)) w
  | .fixed e => C (I.val e)
  | .psi e a c => bind₁ (fun i => getPoly vals (a i)) (I.psi (I.val e) c)
  | .guard e a => bind₁ (fun i => getPoly vals (a i)) (I.guard (I.val e))
